{
  "dataset_name": "letter",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "box_aspect_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Width-to-height ratio of the bounding box, capturing glyph shape proportion useful as a smooth linear feature.",
      "formula": "(width + 1.0) / (high + 1.0)",
      "value_range": [0.0625, 16.0],
      "feature_family": "geometric_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth ratio separating tall vs wide glyphs along a single linear axis.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "box_area_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized bounding box area scaled to [0,1] via log1p compression for linear projection stability.",
      "formula": "np.log1p(width * high) / np.log1p(225.0)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "geometric_size",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compressed area gives a smooth scale feature compatible with linear margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "pixel_density",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Fraction of bounding box filled by on-pixels, a smooth density measure.",
      "formula": "onpix / np.maximum(width * high, 1.0)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "density",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Density discriminates dense vs sparse glyphs and is naturally bounded for SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "centroid_offset_x",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized horizontal centroid deviation from box center, capturing horizontal asymmetry.",
      "formula": "(x-bar - 7.5) / 7.5",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "position",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Centered/normalized centroid gives a clean linear projection axis.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "centroid_offset_y",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized vertical centroid deviation from box center.",
      "formula": "(y-bar - 7.5) / 7.5",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "position",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Vertical centroid asymmetry as a smooth linear feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "variance_ratio_xy",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of horizontal to vertical pixel variance, characterizing elongation direction.",
      "formula": "(x2bar + 1.0) / (y2bar + 1.0)",
      "value_range": [0.0625, 16.0],
      "feature_family": "shape_moment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth ratio of second-moment terms provides a linear separation axis.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "edge_density_x",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Horizontal edge count normalized by box width, smooth severity of horizontal strokes.",
      "formula": "x-ege / (width + 1.0)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 14.0],
      "feature_family": "edge_density",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Per-unit-width edge density gives a stable linear feature for stroke complexity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "edge_density_y",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Vertical edge count normalized by box height.",
      "formula": "y-ege / (high + 1.0)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 14.0],
      "feature_family": "edge_density",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Per-unit-height edge density complements x-edge density linearly.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "edge_balance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Signed difference between vertical and horizontal edge densities, normalized.",
      "formula": "(y-ege - x-ege) / (y-ege + x-ege + 1.0)",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "edge_balance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Bounded signed score separates horizontally vs vertically structured glyphs.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "correlation_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite of cross-moment terms capturing diagonal structure (xybar, x2ybr, xy2br) standardized.",
      "formula": "(xybar - 8.26) / 2.47 + (x2ybr - 6.45) / 2.59 + (xy2br - 7.94) / 2.07",
      "value_range": [-12.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "shape_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear sum of standardized cross-moments forms an approximate projection useful to SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "stroke_compactness",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Heuristic compactness score combining on-pixel count with bounding box perimeter; higher means more compact glyph.",
      "formula": "onpix / (2.0 * (width + high) + 1.0)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 7.5],
      "feature_family": "shape_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures compactness vs sparseness of stroke distribution as a smooth severity score.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "shape_regularity_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Judgment of glyph regularity: low absolute centroid offsets plus balanced variance suggest symmetric shape.",
      "formula": "1.0 - np.clip((np.abs(x-bar - 7.5) + np.abs(y-bar - 7.5)) / 15.0 + np.abs(x2bar - y2bar) / 15.0, 0.0, 1.0)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "symmetry_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Bounded regularity score provides a smooth interpretable axis for linear SVM margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
